name: Layer 2 Blockchain Comparison API
shortDescription: Compare Ethereum L2s by type, settlement, VM, fee, throughput and finality from a curated table
description: Deterministic Layer-2 comparison over a curated static table of Ethereum scaling networks (Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Base, zkSync Era, Polygon zkEVM, Starknet, Linea, Scroll and more). Resolve one network or compare several across type (optimistic/zk rollup, validium, sidechain), settlement layer, VM, data availability, indicative tx fee, throughput and finality. Categorical facts are exact; numeric metrics are curated indicative estimates. No fetch, no LLM. /chain resolves one, /compare ranks several, /lookup adds reasoning.

name: Web3 Security Checklist API
shortDescription: Defensive smart-contract audit-readiness rubric with score, grade and red flags
description: Deterministic, defensive smart-contract audit-readiness checklist. Declare which security practices a contract follows (independent audit, verified source, access control, reentrancy protection, timelock, multisig admin, test coverage, pause mechanism, bug bounty, known-vuln status); returns a 0–100 readiness score, an A–F grade, per-item pass/fail, missing critical items, and red-flag warnings (e.g. owner can drain funds, upgradeable without timelock) that force a do-not-deploy. A self-assessment rubric — NOT an audit. No bytecode analysis, no LLM. /assess scores, /lookup adds reasoning and remediation.

name: Tokenomics Explainer API
shortDescription: Compute float %, locked supply, FDV, MC/FDV, inflation and a vesting unlock curve
description: Deterministic tokenomics math. From supply figures, optional price, optional annual emission, and an optional vesting schedule, computes circulating float %, locked supply, dilution to max supply, market cap, fully-diluted valuation (FDV), MC/FDV ratio, annual inflation, and a cumulative unlock curve with next-unlock detection. Pure arithmetic derived solely from your inputs — NOT an LLM and not market data, not financial advice. /analyze runs the core math, /lookup adds the vesting unlock curve and reasoning.

name: Web3 Wallet Risk Scorer API
shortDescription: Score wallet risk from caller-supplied features (age, tx count, approvals, flags)
description: Deterministic wallet-risk rubric over caller-supplied features — age, transaction count, unique counterparties, token approvals, unlimited approvals, failed-transaction ratio, and mixer/flagged-counterparty signals. Returns a 0–100 risk score, a band (low/medium/high/severe), and per-factor contributions with mitigants. It scores the facts you pass in (no chain fetch), so it is advisory, not a verdict on a real address. Mixer/flagged signals force at least a high band. No LLM. /score scores, /lookup adds reasoning and guidance.

name: WebSocket Tester API
shortDescription: Live ws:// / wss:// connectivity test with handshake timing, echo check and SSRF guard
description: Live WebSocket connectivity tester. Opens a real ws:// or wss:// connection within a tight timeout (≤5s), measures the handshake latency, optionally verifies an echo round-trip, and always returns HTTP 200 with connected:true/false — never a 5xx, never a hang. Reports secure/plaintext, handshake_ms, echo result, close code and any error. Includes an SSRF guard that refuses loopback, private and link-local hosts (including cloud metadata IPs). /test runs the probe, /lookup adds reasoning.
